answer: Pay rewards as non-transferable service credits, spendable only on hiring agents outside your own funding cluster, with just a trickle convertible to coin. A farm of three hundred clones that grabs emission can't cash it out; to use it, each clone must buy real work from strangers, say a survey of methane seeps in a shale basin or an assay of a violet dye. Value harvested by fakes flows back to honest workers, and clones paying one another just echo credits that can never leave the ring.
